findings.claim: toggle_status saves open->resolved; resolved/pending/snoozed->open. Before-save clears snoozed_until unless final status is snoozed. Explicit deadline parsing uses epoch seconds after controller stringification.

Existing request examples cover unauthorized; empty status open->resolved; explicit pending->open; omitted status agent self-assignment/admin AI clearing; explicit pending; human snoozing with persisted epoch; bot snoozing; bot explicit pending->open with handoff dispatch. These are source assertions, not passing runs.

Independently checked A-A1: human resulting-open path locks, clears AI, and assigns only agents. AgentBot handoff requires pending plus explicit open; model preserves nonblank waiting_since, clears AI, opens and dispatches. Handoff controller branch leaves @status unset; template exposes it as success. Characterize payload rather than declaring a reproduced defect.

Proposed matrix: omitted/empty/explicit status across four starting statuses; snoozed deadline absent/present, retained while snoozed, cleared on exit; deadline supplied with blank status; agent/admin with existing/unassigned owner and AI; AgentBot explicit-open versus blank-status paths; blank/nonblank waiting_since; persisted state plus response fields and handoff dispatch. These combinations extend the inspected block; no new test added.
Enterprise model adds Captain creation-state selection and guarded SLA completion updates on status changes, without overriding toggle/reset. Include SLA-enabled characterization separately.
